claims.country: India is absent from the published 25-country restriction list.
claims.conditions: Service remains conditional on local law, sanctions, KYC, and third-party availability.

claims.checkout: Maven publishes credit-card and other checkout options and requires the trader to own the card.
claims.kyc: Veriff accepts government-issued ID and requires identity details to match the trader.
claims.payout: India appears in the Rise-or-other-options group rather than the named direct-bank group.
claims.fee: Payments through Rise carry a published $20 withdrawal fee.

claims.currency: Captured account sizes, fees, and after-pass amounts are displayed in USD.
